source_witness.review: cfg(test) input-chunking regressions only. Example 1 asserts 281 decoded bytes and Adler32 751299; the first-party standard-library raw decoder independently confirms both and a complete raw DEFLATE stream. Example 3 asserts BadLiteralLengthHuffmanTree; independent bit decoding confirms its absent EOB, complete Huffman declaration and 35 remaining zero bits. Example 2 is also a cfg(test) input-chunking regression expecting BadLiteralLengthHuffmanTree. Its nonfinal dynamic declaration lacks EOB; all 295 code lengths, 42 unreachable trailing bits and stored checksum are independently bound. The tail is not decoded or called padding.

scope: Only three exact regression-data paths, lengths and hashes. All intentionally invalid zlib streams. No generic broken-checksum, compression-error, archive or package waiver.
limitations: The original fdeflate crate/test suite is never imported, compiled or run. Python standard-library zlib decodes only the bounded raw payload for example 1.
Malformed-input downstream parser safety is not certified. Generic bad checksum/DEFLATE data remains blocked.
No original compressed binary or encoded copy is committed.

Example 2 has no valid DEFLATE block sequence or output. Its nonzero tail is only a fixed, unreachable bit sequence after an invalid first-block declaration; this does not prove downstream parser safety.
